macro.title: Inflation Trend
macro.body: The current inflation trend may have a moderate impact on the portfolio, as rising inflation could lead to higher interest rates and affect the performance of leveraged ETFs. The portfolio's 3x leverage amplifies both gains and losses, making it sensitive to market fluctuations.
macro.bull: A controlled inflation environment could support the portfolio's growth, as it would indicate a healthy economy and potentially lead to higher stock prices.
macro.base: A stable inflation rate would likely result in minimal net change to the portfolio, as it would not significantly impact the performance of the leveraged ETFs.
macro.bear: High inflation could negatively impact the portfolio, as it would lead to higher interest rates and potentially decrease the value of the leveraged ETFs.

macro.title: FX Fluctuations
macro.body: The portfolio's significant USD exposure (~68%) makes it vulnerable to FX fluctuations. A strong USD could negatively impact the portfolio's CAD value, while a weak USD could have a positive impact.
macro.bull: A weakening USD could increase the portfolio's CAD value, as the USD-denominated assets would be worth more in CAD.
macro.base: A stable USD would likely result in minimal net change to the portfolio, as it would not significantly impact the performance of the USD-denominated assets.
macro.bear: A strong USD could decrease the portfolio's CAD value, as the USD-denominated assets would be worth less in CAD.

macro.title: Sector Rotation
macro.body: The portfolio's sector allocation, with a significant weight in tech, may be affected by sector rotation. A rotation out of tech could negatively impact the portfolio, while a rotation into tech could have a positive impact.
macro.bull: A rotation into tech could increase the portfolio's value, as the tech stocks would be in high demand.
macro.base: A stable sector allocation would likely result in minimal net change to the portfolio, as it would not significantly impact the performance of the tech stocks.
macro.bear: A rotation out of tech could decrease the portfolio's value, as the tech stocks would be less in demand.

risks.title: Leverage Amplification Risk
risks.context: 49% of portfolio (~ $135K CAD) in leveraged ETFs
risks.body: The portfolio's significant allocation to leveraged ETFs amplifies both gains and losses, making it vulnerable to market fluctuations. A downturn in the market could result in significant losses.

risks.title: FX Exposure Risk
risks.body: The portfolio's significant USD exposure makes it vulnerable to FX fluctuations. A strong USD could negatively impact the portfolio's CAD value.

risks.title: Single-Stock Risk
risks.body: The portfolio's significant allocation to NVDA, with a never-sell position, makes it vulnerable to company-specific risks. A downturn in NVDA's stock price could result in significant losses.

news.headline: Nvidia Shorts
news.body: Michael Burry's warning of a potential 1987-style crash and his short position in Nvidia may impact the portfolio's NVDA holding.

outcomes.label: Bull
outcomes.scenario: Nvidia's stock price increases despite Burry's warning, resulting in gains for the portfolio.

outcomes.label: Base
outcomes.scenario: Nvidia's stock price remains stable, resulting in minimal net change to the portfolio.

outcomes.label: Bear
outcomes.scenario: Nvidia's stock price decreases due to Burry's warning, resulting in losses for the portfolio.

news.headline: US-Iran Talks
news.body: The ongoing US-Iran talks may impact the portfolio's energy holdings, such as ENB.TO.

outcomes.label: Bull
outcomes.scenario: A successful US-Iran deal leads to increased oil production, negatively impacting ENB.TO's stock price.

outcomes.label: Base
outcomes.scenario: The US-Iran talks have a minimal impact on the portfolio's energy holdings.

outcomes.label: Bear
outcomes.scenario: A failed US-Iran deal leads to decreased oil production, positively impacting ENB.TO's stock price.

news.headline: TSMC N3 Node
news.body: Nvidia and Google's crowding of TSMC's N3 node may impact the portfolio's TSM holding.

outcomes.label: Bull
outcomes.scenario: TSMC's N3 node crowding leads to increased demand for TSM's products, positively impacting the stock price.

outcomes.label: Base
outcomes.scenario: The crowding of TSMC's N3 node has a minimal impact on the portfolio's TSM holding.

outcomes.label: Bear
outcomes.scenario: The crowding of TSMC's N3 node leads to decreased demand for TSM's products, negatively impacting the stock price.

strategy_short.text: Monitor the US-Iran talks and their potential impact on the energy sector
Keep a close eye on Nvidia's stock price and potential company-specific risks
Consider rebalancing the portfolio to maintain an optimal asset allocation

Explore opportunities to diversify the portfolio and reduce sector-specific risks
Maintain a disciplined approach to risk management and leverage control
